title: Nearest coefficient rounding attains quadratic closed-word error
body:
This scoped lower construction answers the deterministic-rounding question in [PR #5153](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5153). Nearest rounding of a fixed rational shear coefficient produces error proportional to the square of the exact prefix envelope. It applies to unchanged emitted words; a compiler can remove the symbolic zero loops. The complete kappa calculation is unchanged.

[Proof and scope](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/669770ece21ceb5e20d0bec00bd5393d7373ff54/research/nearest-closed-word-lower-bound/README.md), [exact checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/669770ece21ceb5e20d0bec00bd5393d7373ff54/research/nearest-closed-word-lower-bound/verify.py), [replay declaration](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/669770ece21ceb5e20d0bec00bd5393d7373ff54/research/nearest-closed-word-lower-bound/VERIFY.json), and [source provenance](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/669770ece21ceb5e20d0bec00bd5393d7373ff54/research/nearest-closed-word-lower-bound/SOURCES.json) are pinned to the reviewed commit. Base: canonical main `ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf`, priority revision 7.

The initial proof and standalone check are in [Discussion #5294](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5294).

CPython 3.12.14 registered normal and optimized replays passed: 288 cases, 6,876 prefixes, 96 small-error cases and four controls. Both print `PASS_DETERMINISTIC_CLOSED_WORD`; the launcher prints `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`. All five package files match their committed bytes, and the base is an ancestor of the package commit.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/nearest-closed-word-lower-bound
```

Use Python 3.12 and the standard library. No external runtime inputs or third-party Python packages are required. Hosted planning and the registered package replay passed on this exact head in [run 39990269905](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39990269905). No predecessor scientific suite, selected cold replay, native replay, compiler, Lean or Docker build was run. The optional full-history preflight is unavailable in this shallow checkout. Finite checks corroborate the written proof; they do not constitute independent human or proof-kernel acceptance.

Test which exact coefficient relations a production storage policy preserves. Source preparation, native operations, precision, movement, and supplier/outer admission remain separate obligations.

Credit Nick Petalas's [PR #5153](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5153) for the open deterministic-policy question and the retained sharp-power context, ywz65's [PR #2701](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2701) for the simultaneous-error theorem, and Vlado Vojdanovski's [PR #1673](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1673) for the Toeplitz precision interface.
